entries.task: Record the person's brief in docs/planning/brief.md and write docs/planning/solution-plan.md for the Daylight Clock: a generalization of the existing single-page quadi-dozenal clock (D:\quadi-dozenal-clock-v3.html) that lets the user choose how the day is divided -- 24x60x60 by default, with a built-in 48x48x48 option (the "48 clock") -- delivered as an installable, offline-capable static web app for phones. The plan states the objective, the production split (one static web app, no server tier, no database), the handoff artifact (the static site folder), the module(s) with their contracts and the cuts deferred (including a native Wear OS watch face), and the phases with their key deliverables: importing the existing page, the two-system time model and faces (Z removed from the zan hand; 24x60x60 face with 0-3 quarter-day majors and 2/4 minors, base-10 24-hour digital readout), showing the other system's reading under the digital display, an About page explaining the 48 clock and the daylight/longest-day/shortest-day markings, and PWA installability.
